import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import uuid, shutil

path = '/conf/config.xml'
shutil.copy(path, path + '.bak')

def uid():
    return str(uuid.uuid4())

servers = hap.find('servers')
srv1_id, srv2_id = uid(), uid()

def add_server(parent, sid, name, addr, port):
    s = ET.SubElement(parent, 'server')
    s.set('uuid', sid)
    ET.SubElement(s, 'enabled').text = '1'
    ET.SubElement(s, 'name').text = name
    ET.SubElement(s, 'address').text = addr
    ET.SubElement(s, 'port').text = str(port)
    ET.SubElement(s, 'mode').text = 'active'
    ET.SubElement(s, 'type').text = 'static'
    ET.SubElement(s, 'ssl').text = '0'
    ET.SubElement(s, 'sslVerify').text = '1'

add_server(servers, srv1_id, 'node2_backend', '10.100.168.11', 8080)
add_server(servers, srv2_id, 'node3_backend', '10.100.168.12', 8080)

backends = hap.find('backends')
be_id = uid()
be = ET.SubElement(backends, 'backend')
be.set('uuid', be_id)
ET.SubElement(be, 'enabled').text = '1'
ET.SubElement(be, 'name').text = 'web_backend'
ET.SubElement(be, 'mode').text = 'http'
ET.SubElement(be, 'algorithm').text = 'roundrobin'
ET.SubElement(be, 'random_draws').text = '2'
ET.SubElement(be, 'linkedServers').text = ','.join([srv1_id, srv2_id])

frontends = hap.find('frontends')
fe = ET.SubElement(frontends, 'frontend')
fe.set('uuid', uid())
ET.SubElement(fe, 'enabled').text = '1'
ET.SubElement(fe, 'name').text = 'web_frontend'
ET.SubElement(fe, 'bind').text = '10.100.168.10:80'
ET.SubElement(fe, 'mode').text = 'http'
ET.SubElement(fe, 'defaultBackend').text = be_id
ET.SubElement(fe, 'ssl_enabled').text = '0'

general = hap.find('general')
general.find('enabled').text = '1'

tree.write(path, xml_declaration=True, encoding='utf-8')
print('OK', srv1_id, srv2_id, be_id)

#!/bin/sh

if [ -f /etc/rc.conf.d/haproxy ]; then
. /etc/rc.conf.d/haproxy
fi

# NOTE: Keep /var/haproxy on this list, see GH issue opnsense/plugins #39.
HAPROXY_DIRS="/var/haproxy /var/haproxy/sockets /var/haproxy/var/run /tmp/haproxy /tmp/haproxy/ssl /tmp/haproxy/lua /tmp/haproxy/errorfiles /tmp/haproxy/mapfiles /tmp/haproxy/sockets"

for directory in ${HAPROXY_DIRS}; do
    mkdir -p ${directory}
    chown -R www:www ${directory}
    chmod -R 750 ${directory}
done

# chroot dir must not be writable
find /var/haproxy -type d -exec chmod 550 {} \;

# export required data to filesystem
/usr/local/opnsense/scripts/OPNsense/HAProxy/exportCerts.php > /dev/null 2>&1
/usr/local/opnsense/scripts/OPNsense/HAProxy/exportLuaScripts.php > /dev/null 2>&1
/usr/local/opnsense/scripts/OPNsense/HAProxy/exportErrorFiles.php > /dev/null 2>&1
/usr/local/opnsense/scripts/OPNsense/HAProxy/exportMapFiles.php > /dev/null 2>&1

# deploy new config
case "$1" in
deploy)
    # run syntax check against newly generated config
    if /usr/local/sbin/haproxy -c -f /usr/local/etc/haproxy.conf.staging > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        cp /usr/local/etc/haproxy.conf.staging /usr/local/etc/haproxy.conf
    fi
    ;;
esac

exit 0
